method: Pinned @font-face; zero margins/padding; absolute text box at top:20px with Hxy. Read a zero-size inline-block aligned to the baseline, subtracting the 20px origin. Canvas fontBoundingBoxAscent/Descent provide independent font-box measurements. Mixed-size controls use a 20px/1.5 parent and 48px/1 child with a 2px bottom border.
fractional_origin_method: Read saved Chrome print PDF text-object baselines with PDFium. Six plain/span/color/nested/generated-content panels use identical typography at each fractional absolute origin; all text objects share the retained baseline. Font, source and reference PDF hashes are pinned.
integral_origin_method: Read absolute text-object baselines in 132 saved Chrome print PDFs and compare with independently observed DOM baselines. Two explicit font files, eight sizes, unit/1.5 line heights, four quarter-pixel origins; additionally Inter54px/800 at the Acme header origin. Inter @font-face declares its100-900 weight range.
